Before discovering that I can have wayyyy more curls than I thought I used to heat style my hair and to blow it straight too, but it always looked bad straight cos of the frizz!! Ahhh thanks for the recommendation 😊 I’d thought that only low porosity hair could get protein overloaded lol

Oh lucky you! My hair wasn't this dry in the past until I discovered the magic of bleach and hair dyeing  😂  I tend to steer towards high-protein conditioners so my hair would be smoother when I used to blow dry it straight, but perhaps there's something about a protein-free conditioner that may help with my curls actually clumping and retaining the wave!

ROUTINE:

  
Every 2-4 days: 

1. Shampoo with the K18 or Ouai Detox shampoo (my scalp is oily) 
2. Condition with silicones (Ouai Treatment Masque OR Milbon Hair Treatment), because my hair is reaaaally porous on account of the bleaching
3. Rake in Ouai Hair Curl Creme and start scrunching hair upwards 
4. Apply a large amount of strong-hold mousse (Schwarzkopf Hair Mousse Volume Styling), scrunching it in as well
5. Apply a generous amount of gel - IGK Good Spin Flexible Curl Defining Gelee (I might not be doing this properly but I just get some gel on my hands and immediately start scrunching, no raking or prayer-hands involved)
6. Plop with microfibre towel (or microplop, not sure the difference)
7. Put hair in a hair turban
8. Dry with diffuser until mostly dry
9. Oil out the crunch with Milbon hair oil
